posts.text:
One million-mile trucker @adamlwingfield in new interview after going to the Tesla Semi launch event a couple weeks ago:

“The trucking industry has adopted technology so much slower. As we toured the @Tesla Semi factory, I’m just like, wow, this doesn’t feel like trucking. It feels like transportation innovation. I’ve been in this industry a long time. I am an old-school industry veteran. You can’t tell me nothing about trucking that I don’t know. But walking away (from the event), I was like, "This industry is going to be changed."

Adam's full 1+ hour interview with Motortrend: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r40-7gM4MAo&t=112s
